resources.string: Copying and validating models. Please wait…

Reads external models without keeping private copies. Keep source files in place and do not modify them. Import with copy mode to use private copies; reference mode removes existing private copies. Removing references preserves source files. The PP-OCR runtime component still needs installation in app-private storage.
The external model has the wrong size or does not support direct reading/mapping. Select a compatible file or use “Copy to app-private storage”.
An external model changed, its permission expired, or it is unavailable. Select the model files again.
Remove the reference to “%1$s”? External source files will be kept.
Select all the files below at once. Names and versions must match. After all files pass validation, they are copied or referenced using the selected method. Source files are kept.\n\n%1$s
